description: Performs one or more clicks on a specified page target, using a current target ID or stable selector and returning guidance when the click handles a page alert, opens an interactive dialog on the page, or triggers a file-upload request.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the click target.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the click target.

id.description: Current target ID from a recent DOM.getAXTree or DOM.getSemanticTree result.

force.description: Attempt the click even when the target is currently covered. The page may still reject or ignore the interaction.

clickCount.description: Number of clicks to dispatch, from 1 to 100.

purpose.description: Describe the intended effect of this click, e.g., opening a menu, selecting a result, or submitting a form

target.description: Target identity used for the click.

recoveredTarget.description: Updated target information when the original target changed.

clickCount.description: Requested click count, present only when the full sequence completed.

point.description: Page point used for the click, when available.

dialog.description: Page dialog returned by this click; handled alerts are not returned here.

id.description: Dialog ID to pass to Page.handleDialog.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

truncated.description: Whether the dialog message was shortened.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

target.description: Target identity used for the click.

recoveredTarget.description: Updated target information when the original target changed.

clickCount.description: Requested click count, present only when the full sequence completed.

point.description: Page point used for the click, when available.

dialog.description: Page dialog returned by this click; handled alerts are not returned here.

id.description: Dialog ID to pass to Page.handleDialog.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

truncated.description: Whether the dialog message was shortened.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
